data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Jul 5, 2026

## [I purchased the Cleo buffet for…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a4a410b4272ec3984e722bd)
I purchased the Cleo buffet for $3500.00 on June 12th. I am not sure when it is due to ship, but I don’t have it yet. That is not the issue though. It is now on sale for $2450.00. I reached out to ask you to honor the sale price and was told no. I could understand if I already had it in my possession, but I don’t even have it yet.

June 29, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 6, 2026

Hi Suzanne,

Thank you for your feedback! We’re happy to adjust the price for your purchase if it was made within 7 days of our promotion. The adjustment will be issued as store credit, and please note that it does not include tax or shipping fees. Please follow up with our Trade support team, they are here to help via email, live chat, text, or phone during regular business hours. Thank you for your understanding.

Lulu and Georgia
